result.topic_en: Calculations involving integrals of products of cos√(1−λ)x and cos√(−1−λ)x with functions u_1, u_2 over [−a,a], boundary terms, and the solution of the ordinary differential equation ∂²v/∂y²+λv=P by integrating factors, apparently for an eigenvalue/boundary-value problem of a fourth-order PDE.
result.transcription:
$(\lambda+\nu)\cos\sqrt{-1-\lambda}\,a\int_{-a}^{+a}\cos\sqrt{1-\lambda}\,x\,.\,u_1\,\partial x$
$+(\lambda-\nu)\cos\sqrt{1-\lambda}\,a\int_{-a}^{+a}\cos\sqrt{-1-\lambda}\,x\cdot u_2\,\partial x$
$+2u_a\sqrt{1-\lambda}\sin\sqrt{1-\lambda}\,a\,\cos\sqrt{-1-\lambda}\,a\,\frac{\lambda+\nu}{\lambda-\nu}$
$+2\frac{\partial u}{\partial x}_a[-\nu-]\cos\sqrt{1-\lambda}\,a\,\cos\sqrt{-1-\lambda}\,a\,\lambda$
$= 2\nu[?]\lambda\cos\sqrt{1-\lambda}\,a\cos\sqrt{-1-\lambda}\,a\,U_\lambda$
[-$\left((\lambda+\nu)^2(\cos\sqrt{-1-\lambda}\,a)^2 + (\lambda-\nu)^2(\cos\sqrt{1-\lambda}\,a)^2\right)a,\ A_\lambda\cos\sqrt{\lambda}y$-]

$\frac{\partial^2 u}{\partial x^2}+\frac{\partial^2 u}{\partial y^2}=\frac{1}{\nu}\frac{\partial^2 u}{\partial y^2}\quad x=\pm a$
$\frac{\partial^3 u}{\partial x^3}+\frac{\partial^3 u}{\partial y^2\partial x}=-\frac{1}{\nu}\frac{\partial^3 u}{\partial y^2\partial x}$

$\int_{-a}^{+a}\left(\cos\sqrt{1-\lambda}\,x\,[-\ldots-]\frac{\partial^2 u_1}{\partial x^2}+\frac{\partial^2 u_1}{\partial y^2}+u_1\right)\partial x$
$=2\frac{\partial u_1}{\partial x}_a\cos\sqrt{1-\lambda}\,a+2u_{1a}\sqrt{1-\lambda}\sin\sqrt{1-\lambda}\,a+\frac{\partial^2 v_1}{\partial y^2}+\lambda v_1=0$

$u_1=\frac12\left(u-\frac{\partial^2 u}{\partial x^2}-\frac{\partial^2 u}{\partial y^2}\right)$
$u_2=-\frac12\left(u+\frac{\partial^2 u}{\partial x^2}+\frac{\partial^2 u}{\partial y^2}\right)$

$\int_{-a}^{+a}\cos\sqrt{-1-\lambda}\,x\left(\frac{\partial^2 u_2}{\partial x^2}+\frac{\partial^2 u_2}{\partial y^2}-u_2\right)\partial x$
$=2\frac{\partial u_2}{\partial x}\cos\sqrt{-1-\lambda}\,a+2u_2\sqrt{-1-\lambda}\sin\sqrt{-1-\lambda}\,a+\frac{\partial^2 v_2}{\partial y^2}+\lambda v_2=0$

[-$\lambda^2u_a+\ldots$-] $2\left(\frac{\partial^2 u}{\partial y^2}+\lambda u\right)\sqrt{1-\lambda}\sin\sqrt{1-\lambda}\,a\cos\sqrt{-1-\lambda}\,a\,\frac{\lambda+\nu}{\lambda-\nu}$
$+2\left(\frac{\partial^3 u}{\partial y^2\partial x}+\lambda\frac{\partial u}{\partial x}\right)\cos\sqrt{1-\lambda}\,a\cos\sqrt{-1-\lambda}\,a$

$2\left(\lambda\frac{\partial u_1}{\partial x}+\left(\frac{\lambda+\nu}{\nu}-\frac{\lambda-\nu}{\nu}\right)\frac{\partial^3 u}{\partial y^2\partial x}\right)\cos\sqrt{1-\lambda}\,a\cos\sqrt{-1-\lambda}\,a$

$\frac{\partial^2 v}{\partial y^2}+\lambda v=P\qquad \partial e^{[?]}\left(\frac{\partial v}{\partial y}+\sqrt{-\lambda}\,v\right)$
$e^{-y\sqrt{-\lambda}}\left(\frac{\partial v}{\partial y}+\sqrt{-\lambda}\,v\right)=\int P e^{-y\sqrt{-\lambda}}\partial y\qquad v=\frac{1}{\sqrt{\lambda}}\int_0^y P\sin\sqrt{\lambda}(y-\eta)\,\partial\eta+a\cos\sqrt{\lambda}\,y$
$e^{y\sqrt{-\lambda}}\left(\frac{\partial v}{\partial y}-\sqrt{-\lambda}\,v\right)=\int P e^{y\sqrt{-\lambda}}\partial y$

$P\cos\sqrt{\lambda-2}\,z\,\partial z$
